name: oxacan
description: OXACAN — plateforme SaaS pour les professionnels du bâtiment (Suisse). Monorepo.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/engine && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck -w packages/engine && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
